headline_hook: 25 Open-Weight Models Ship in One Week While a 20B Agent Cracks Frontier Search
preview_topics: a 20B agent that outpunches its weight class

pick_of_the_day.thesis: Harness-1 matching frontier search at 20B parameters by externalizing state proves the next leap in AI agents won't come from scaling context windows — it'll come from rethinking what the model needs to hold in its head at all.

model_literacy.relevance: Harness-1 achieves frontier-level long-horizon search by offloading working memory to external storage instead of cramming everything into context. As today's open-weight avalanche puts capable base models in everyone's hands, state externalization may matter more than parameter count for building agents that actually work.

items.title: Harness-1 Cracks Frontier Search With Just 20B Parameters
items.angle: A state-externalizing architecture lets a model 10x smaller than GPT-class compete on long-horizon search — the implications for agent design are enormous
items.key_fact: 20B parameter model achieves frontier-level performance on long-horizon search benchmarks
